newsitem.title: USA: Ultimate Electronics Oct sales down at $20.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Ultimate Electronics Oct sales down at $20.3 mln.

text.p: Ultimate Electronics Inc said sales for October were $20.3 million, a 13-percent decrease from sales of $23.4 million for the same month last year.
It said comparable store sales decreased 24 percent for the month without giving any figures.

The company said sales for the quarter ending October 31 were $60.9 million, a 3.0-percent drop from sales of $62.5 million last year. Comparable store sales fell 20 percent for the quarter, it added.

It said sales for the nine months ending October 31 were $177.6 million, a 9.0-percent rise from sales of $163.3 million for the same period in 1995. Comparable store sales dropped 15 percent for the nine months, it said.
Ultimate Electronics is a specialty retailer of home entertainment and consumer electronics products.
